# ImFusion Web SDK

The ImFusion Web SDK brings medical image processing and visualization to the browser.
It provides a WebAssembly build of the ImFusion SDK, with JavaScript and
TypeScript APIs for loading, processing, and displaying medical images in web applications.

For React applications, see [@imfusion/sdk-react](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@imfusion/sdk-react).

Documentation: [docs.imfusion.com/websdk](https://docs.imfusion.com/websdk).

See [websdk-demo.imfusion.com](https://websdk-demo.imfusion.com) for a live demo.

## Installation

```sh
npm install @imfusion/sdk
```

## Getting Started

Add a canvas to your page:

```html
<canvas id="canvas"></canvas>
```

Initialize the SDK, then load and display a dataset:

```ts
import { init } from '@imfusion/sdk';

const canvas = document.getElementById('canvas') as HTMLCanvasElement;
const imf = await init(canvas);

const data = await imf.loadFileFromUrl('/data/scan.nii.gz');
imf.showAll(data);
```
